'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Humanitarian aid during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] begins airdropping [[humanitarian aid]] into the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-68457937 (BBC News)]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***The Gaza Health Ministry reported that at least 92 [[Palestinians]] are killed in [[Israel]]i attacks in the past 24 hours. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/2/israels-war-on-gaza-live-un-medics-say-many-gaza-aid-attack-victims-shot (Al Jazeera)]
*** Fifteen people are killed in an Israeli attack on a home in [[Deir el-Balah]], while another eleven are killed in an attack on a tent housing displaced Palestinians near Tal Al-Sultan Hospital in [[Rafah]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/3/2/israels-war-on-gaza-live-un-medics-say-many-gaza-aid-attack-victims-shot (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***[[Yemen]]'s internationally-recognized government reports that the abandoned ship {{MV|Rubymar||2}} that was struck by a [[Houthi]] [[anti-ship missile]] has sunk. [https://www.reuters.com/world/freighter-rubymar-has-sunk-red-sea-yemen-internationally-recognised-government-2024-03-02/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nd.nl/varia/varia/1214898/jemen-meldt-dat-beschoten-vrachtschip-rubymar-is-gezonken (Nederlands Dagblad)]
***[[Italian Navy]] destroyer [[Italian destroyer Caio Duilio|''Caio Duilio'']] shoots down a Houthi drone in self-defence while in the [[Red Sea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/italian-naval-ship-shoots-down-drone-red-sea-2024-03-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Bombing of Odesa (2022–present)|Bombing of Odesa]]
***Eight people, including two children, are killed and eight others are injured in a [[Russia]]n [[drone strike]] on an apartment block in [[Odesa]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3834914-body-of-eighth-victim-found-under-rubble-in-odesa.html (Ukrinform)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pakistan floods]]
**Twenty-two people are killed and 25 others are injured across [[Pakistan]] by heavy snow and rainfall. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1818624/22-killed-as-rain-snowfall-batter-kp-for-second-day (Dawn)]
*Three people are killed after a [[Van's RV-10]] crashes near [[Barreiras]], [[Bahia]], [[Brazil]]. [https://asn.flightsafety.org/wikibase/352149 (Aviation Safety Network)]
*More than 30 people are injured after a bus lost control and overturned in [[Tamil Nadu]], [[India]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/chennai/govt-bus-tamil-nadu-topples-passengers-injured-9192170/?ref=archive_pg (The Indian Express)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Two people were killed and four others are injured after a fight escalated into a shooting at an apartment complex frequented by [[University of North Carolina at Pembroke]] students. A teenage student was among the dead. [https://www.wbtw.com/news/state-regional-news/robeson-county/1-unc-pembroke-student-among-2-dead-following-saturday-shooting-near-campus-school-official-says/ (WBTW)]
*[[Northumberland National Park]] announces that the [[Sycamore Gap tree]] which was illegally felled last September is to go on public display. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crg45l285q0o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[2024 Republican Party presidential primaries]]
***[[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] [[caucus]]es are held in [[2024 Idaho Republican presidential caucus|Idaho]], [[2024 Michigan Republican presidential nominating contests|Michigan]], and [[2024 Missouri Republican presidential caucuses|Missouri]] for the 2024 United States presidential election. Former [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] wins all three contests. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/donald-trump-wins-missouri-caucuses-republicans-in-idaho-and-michigan-weigh-in-2024-race/ (CBS News)] [https://apnews.com/article/republican-caucuses-idaho-missouri-michigan-trump-haley-5d3934acc54d6919427cfb025002f15c (AP)]
*[[2024 Dunkley by-election]]
**In [[Australia]], [[Jodie Belyea]] retains the seat of [[Division of Dunkley|Dunkley]] for the [[Australian Labor Party]] despite a notable swing towards the [[Liberal Party of Australia|Liberal Party]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2024-03-02/victorian-winner-dunkley-by-election-labor-jodie-belyea/103532906 (ABC News Australia)]
